_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: TVs and the phone remote, like Google TV's: 1. More > Screens and TVs > Control a screen: screens on the same Wi-Fi show Local, others Live; tap one. 2. Connected bar at the bottom of Go; several screens at once. 3. D-pad or swipe pad, Back, Home, mute and volume (the TV's own), power (screen off/on), keyboard (type into the TV's box). 4. On the screen: the TV's buttons and settings live on the phone; tap one to press it. 5. Microphone: say 'show the last order and mark it done', 'next advert', 'keep this advert for 5 minutes', 'volume up', 'switch to kitchen' (? lists them). 6. Kitchen: new orders fill the screen for 10 s with the chime (Settings or the phone); Open | Closed | Phone orders; Back goes up to the tabs. 7. Switching Kitchen/Customer display changes the TV at once. 8. TV: the first remote key always lands on something, a thick ring shows where; Back on the first screen asks to quit. 9. Every TV shows the same layout whatever its resolution. 10. More > About this screen: name, model, Android, pixels, id. 11. Back from the background: the Vesopa mark while Go refreshes.
release_notes: Vesopa Go on your TV: the kitchen board lays tickets out side by side on Android TV and Google TV, and everything works with the remote. Tap a member's phone or watch to find them: Go reads the members' card by NFC.
